mapper.sql: SELECT b.material_id, m.name AS material_name, m.code, m.spec, c.name AS category_name, u.name AS unit_name, b.quantity, m.safety_stock, b.last_movement_at FROM material m LEFT JOIN stock_balance b ON b.material_id = m.id JOIN unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id JOIN material_category c ON c.id = m.category_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.status <> 'archived'

sql.if: AND m.status = 'active' AND ( coalesce(b.quantity, 0) < 0 OR coalesce(b.quantity, 0) = 0 OR (coalesce(b.quantity, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(b.quantity, 0) < m.safety_stock) OR (coalesce(b.quantity, 0) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stock_movement sm2 WHERE sm2.material_id = m.id AND sm2.type = 'OUT' AND sm2.reversed = false AND sm2.occurred_at > now() - interval '90 days')) )

AND coalesce(b.quantity, 0) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stock_movement sm WHERE sm.material_id = m.id AND sm.type = 'OUT' AND sm.reversed = false AND sm.occurred_at > now() - interval '90 days' )

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM material m LEFT JOIN stock_balance b ON b.material_id = m.id JOIN unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id JOIN material_category c ON c.id = m.category_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.status <> 'archived'
